messages:
marisol: FYI, nightly eval GH Actions spiked tonight — backlog of ~120 jobs and several runner failures. noticed a bunch of 'no space left on device' during artifact upload. anyone else seeing this?
liam: seeing it too. buildkite runners look fine. GH hosted runners are the ones dropping. logs show many parallel matrix shards starting at once.
devon: I think cron overlap is the root cause — we have nightly + adhoc scheduled rollouts that trigger eval workflows. concurrency grouping isn't configured.
marisol: ugh. do we have a quick mitigation? reducing concurrency on GH side or staggering crons?
anna: quick hack: add `concurrency: 
  group: eval-ci-nightly
  cancel-in-progress: false` to the workflow. prevents more than one nightly instance, but matrix will still spawn many shards within that instance.
liam: alternatively, throttle shard parallelism by adding `max-parallel` in buildkite connector or use a redis-backed queue limiter for our runner dispatcher. ben_platform, can we cap at 10 concurrent eval shards from infra?
ben_platform: yes we can enforce a soft cap in the dispatcher. but better long-term is to make the GH workflow emit 'dispatch-to-queue' events instead of trying to run large matrices on GH runners. small change: workflow -> workflow_dispatch -> our dispatcher picks shards respecting capacity.
ci-bot: [automated] eval/nightly-run failed 3 times on gha-runner-1: artifact upload error. https://ci.redwood.example/1923456789/logs
marisol: dispatcher approach sounds right. short-term patch: i'll add concurrency group + lower matrix parallelism to 4, and stagger cron times for the other schedules.
devon: for PR gating we need to be careful — we shouldn't use workflow_run to run on PR context because of token perms. recommendation: keep gate check as a lightweight smoke eval in PR, then schedule full evals post-merge or on trusted schedules.
liam: regarding smoke vs full: we should agree on metric thresholds. current PR check uses `delta_accuracy < 0.01` but that's noisy. propose switching PR gate to use aggregated `regression_rate` over a fixed prompt subset and require p-value > 0.95.
anna: agree. add evaluation harness change: `--metric regression_rate --subset pr_gate_prompts --min_pvalue 0.95`. also add deterministic seeds for vectorized prompts to reduce flakiness.
eval-bot: [hint] use `eval-harness v0.9.3` for the new regression metric. upgrade pr in internal repo: https://git.redwood/internal/eval-harness/pull/482
ben_platform: I'll prototype the dispatcher patch this afternoon. plan: GH workflow emits a small JSON describing model+shard and posts to /internal/queue. dispatcher then schedules to buildkite or private runners based on labels (gpu-type, quantized).
marisol: thanks. action items: 1) marisol: add concurrency + matrix throttle (PR: will open now). 2) ben_platform: prototype dispatcher with queue semantics and capacity enforcement. 3) anna/liam: update eval harness PR gating metric and add deterministic seeds. 4) devon: adjust cron windows to avoid overlaps across regions.
liam: can we also add a single-dashboard widget for 'eval queue depth' in Console? helps SRE and oncall see backpressure.
ben_platform: yes, I'll expose a /metrics endpoint and add a prometheus metric `eval_queue_depth` and a Console dashboard panel.
marisol: perfect. i'll post the small PR once tests pass. thanks team :thumbsup:
ci-bot: [automated] created issue #814: gha-nightly-eval-queue-overrun (assigned to ben_platform)
anna: i'll follow up on the harness PR and add the example CLI snippet to the docs so SEs can mirror the PR gating config.
marisol: closing loop — once dispatcher POC is up, we can move heavy workloads off GH hosted runners and avoid these spikes.
